notes: Overview: mid-market CX platform for ecommerce merchants. Looking to add real-time agent assist + automated summarization to reduce handle time.
Primary technical ask: RAG over multi-source KBs (product docs, order system, user-uploaded images/transcripts) with source-level citations and freshness guarantees.
Quote: 'We need citations on every suggested reply — agents escalate less when they can see sources' — Head of CX (Dana Ruiz).

Latency/throughput targets: agent-assist p95 <= 350ms, p50 ~120ms; throughput target 40-80 req/s per region under steady state; spike handling for Black Friday (5x baseline) with graceful degradation.

Quality constraints: must surface provenance per answer, show top-3 supporting passages, highlight staleness if docs older than 24h. Support eval set: 1k historical tickets + 50 high-priority intents.

Architecture preferences: hybrid retrieval — dense vectors + BM25 fallback; store embeddings in managed vector DB (prefer Dedicated for predictable perf). Need hints on chunking strategy and embedding refresh cadence (aiming for 1h near-real-time updates for order-status related docs).
Cost sensitivity: product team wants cost knobs — batch sizing, quantized model recommendations, TTL caching for repeated queries. Target ARR economics: justify Dedicated commit vs hosted at scale.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration with Okta, audit logs for agent suggestions and exports, KMS for key management; partial EU data residency (EU customers’ PII must stay in EU region).

PoC plan discussed: 2-week ingest + indexing (1k tickets + KB), 1-week latency/citation run with Redwood Optimize suggestions, then production pilot with 50 agents. POC success metrics: 12% AHT reduction, 90% citation coverage, <1% hallucination on annotated eval.
